summary_bullets: Verified the Phase 3 phase_plan_materialize implementation already present on the branch
Applied the larch-logs Mermaid lint exclusion to explicit pre-commit filename inputs

commit_message:
Exclude larch logs from explicit Mermaid lint inputs

Make lint-mermaid-fences apply the existing larch-logs runtime-artifact exclusion to pre-commit explicit filename invocations, not just --changed-only. This keeps relevant-checks from linting committed run-log archives while preserving Mermaid validation for authored docs.
